name: Tololo

skills.name: Meteor
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Black Hole Inversion
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deal Hydro damage equal to 130% of attack to it. If Phase Weakness is exploited, gain 2 points of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Supernova Impact
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deal Physical damage equal to 130% of attack to it. If under the effects of 2 or more buffs, increase damage dealt by 20% and gain 2 points of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Morte Lumina
skills.description: Select 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Hydro damage equal to 180% of attack to it. If under the effects of 3 or more buffs, increases damage dealt by 15% and reduce this skill's cooldown by 2 turns.

skills.name: Aurora Curtain
skills.description:
Fills Confectance Index to maximum at the start of the battle. After attacking, if Confectance Index is at max, consumes all of it and gains 1 instance of an Extra Action. 

At the start of each action, for every 2 points of Confectance Index, gains 1 random buff that lasts until the end of the action. Each time an allied unit delas Hydro damage, this unit gains 1 stack of Lightspike.

summons.name: Stationary Satellite
summons.description: Orbital support satellite fixed in position. At the end of allied turn, deals Hydro damage to target with Gravitational Mark.

skills.name: Call of the Stars
skills.description: At the end of allied turn, deals targetted Hydro damage equal to 130% of ATK to the enemy unit within 7 tile radius around the unit that has Gravitational Mark. If no unit has Gravitational Mark, targets the nearest enemy unit.

skills.name: Sync Standstill
skills.description: Immune to Control effects such as Stun, Taunt, and Command Prohibition.

fortification.effect: If a Phase Weakness is exploited, ignores 15% of Cover damage reduction for this attack.
If under the effects of 3 or more buffs, this attack deals Hydro damage. additionally gain 1 point of Confectance Index.
If under the effects of 3 or more buffs, increase damage dealt by 30% and reduce this skill's cooldown by 3 turns.
During an Extra Action, this unit gains Targeted Attack Boost II, Critical Rate Boost II, Phase Boost II, and Piercing II for 2 turns.
The effects of Lightspike are enhanced, increasing critical rate and critical damage by 2%.
If this kills the target, gain 1 point of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Comet Tail Transit
keys.effect: Extra Action increases mobility by 1 tile.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Principles of Observational Astronomy
keys.effect: When using Black Hole Inversion, applies Congestion to the target for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Invisible Light
keys.effect: When Extra Action is triggered, gains Attack Up II and Damage Up II for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Retrograde Motion
keys.effect: When using Supernova Impact, if an allied unit performs a Support Attack before skill activation, applies Stun to the target for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Galactic Cruise
keys.effect: When exploiting a Phase Weakness, dispels 2 buffs from target before attacking.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Stellar Eclipse
keys.effect: When at max HP and Stability Index, ignore 10% of the target's Cover damage reduction.

keys.name: Common Key - Afterglow
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / When Confectance Index is below max, increases damage dealt by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect: After using an active skill, Tololo gains 2 points of Confectance Index. If an allied unit (apart from Tololo) deals Hydro damage, the cooldown of the active skill Black Hole Inversion is reduced by 1 turn.

keys.name: Expansion Key tier 2
keys.effect:
At the start of the battle, Tololo gains 3 stacks of Stellar Energy Reserve.
At the end of Tololo's action, she gains 1 stack of Observation Advantage for 1 round. If the number of Stationary Satellites on the field has not reached its maximum, consumes 1 stack of Stellar Energy Reserve to summon 1 Stationary Satellite by Tololo's side for 2 rounds.
At the start of every other round, Tololo gains 3 stacks of Stellar Energy Reserve.
After Tololo performs an active attack, applies Gravitational Mark to the target. After a Stationary Satellite deals damage, applies 1 stack of Starlight Refraction to the target. Tololo then gains 1 stack of Orbital Resonance.

source_notes: Extracted from GFL2 Official Release Info Compilation.xlsx with online Dandegate/gfl2.help enrichment.
